jsonld_raw.name: ZARA ILLUSION EDP 30 ML (1.01 FL. OZ.)
jsonld_raw.description:
ZARA ILLUSION EDP 30 ML (1.01 FL. OZ.). It accompanies you at every moment of the day with naturalness and sophistication. A versatile perfume that melts into the skin like a second skin: intimate, elegant, and personal.

Orange blossom provides a delicate floral luminosity, while jasmine introduces a soft and enveloping femininity. Vanilla creates a warm and addictive base that adds depth and a comforting sensation that lingers subtly on the skin.

An intimate and modern fragrance that does not overwhelm, but rather accompanies, leaving an elegant trail that invites closeness.

Floral amber | Natural, elegant, and enveloping.
